cd /workspace/tmp && cat > t16.py << 'PYEOF'
"""Audit accepts alternative negative cycles, rejects bad ones."""
import sys, json, random, copy
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import gen, para, algo
rng=random.Random(4)
tested=0; bad=0
for it in range(200):
    prof=gen.gen_profile(rng)
    cal=para.build_calib(prof)
    if cal.feasible: continue
    fb=gen.gen_fabric(rng, cal.K, maxP=6)
    plan=algo.compile_plan(prof,fb)
    assert plan['status']=='inconsistent'
    assert algo.audit(prof,fb,plan)['valid'], 'own cycle rejected'
    c=plan['cycle']
    # rotations accepted
    for r in range(len(c)):
        rot=c[r:]+c[:r]
        if not algo.audit(prof,fb,{"status":"inconsistent","cycle":rot})['valid']:
            print('rotation rejected',rot); bad+=1
    tested+=1
    # reversed rejected (unless palindromic connectivity)
    rev=list(reversed(c))
    if len(c)>1:
        r=algo.audit(prof,fb,{"status":"inconsistent","cycle":rev})['valid']
        if r and not para.cycle_weight_ok(rev,cal.tails,cal.heads,cal.weights):
            print('bad reverse accepted'); bad+=1
    # empty rejected
    if algo.audit(prof,fb,{"status":"inconsistent","cycle":[]})['valid']: print('empty accepted'); bad+=1
    # out of range id rejected
    if algo.audit(prof,fb,{"status":"inconsistent","cycle":[2*len(prof['measurements'])+5]})['valid']:
        print('oob accepted'); bad+=1
    # truncated (non-closing) rejected
    if len(c)>1:
        t=c[:-1]
        if para.cycle_weight_ok(t,cal.tails,cal.heads,cal.weights)==False:
            if algo.audit(prof,fb,{"status":"inconsistent","cycle":t})['valid']: print('trunc accepted'); bad+=1
    if bad>3: break
print('inconsistent cases tested',tested,'bad',bad)
PYEOF
